summary.summary: With exact interval/symbolic algebra and a covariance-complete log-basis fit, the exact Koide pair (1/2,2/9) misses pole-mass m_mu/m_e by 9.8e-6 (z=442 with the CODATA ratio error, about 450 with quadrature errors; all tau-mass choices), the miss is a scheme-sized O((alpha/pi)^2) quantity, and a reconstructed O(alpha^2) own-scale MSbar map moves m_mu/m_e the wrong way (miss grows to about 2e-5), so neither pole nor own-scale MSbar masses rescue the exact pair, and a fixed-order common-mu MSbar map moves Q by 1.15e-3 (500x the pole offset).
